items.title: Myra Menville Interview, 1958-05-07, 09
items.q: Paul Whiteman and that type of band did more to destroy.

ctx.x: What about, uh, the use of it as entertainment? Uh, really, the years, they tend to fall off during the 30s with the national dance theater.
Oh, as far as jazz was concerned. Paul Whiteman and that type of band did more to destroy. In fact, it's...
I don't even call... I'm a semi-purist. I don't call, uh, Whiteman a swing or progressive, even jazz. For me, jazz just means that... Well, you are a pyrist.
